en: Color multi-view postcard labeled Tirgu Ocna. The front shows: a bust statue on a pedestal in a landscaped park; the domed stone World War I Heroes' Mausoleum (with a Romanian flag) on Măgura hill; and a panoramic view of Târgu Ocna nestled among green hills with a road and bridge. The back has Romanian address lines, the publisher Editura Meridiane, photographers' credits, price in lei, and a boxed area for a stamp.
